sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你制作了终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Hello from our closets.
sentences.zh: 从我们的衣橱里向大家问好。

sentences.en: Still here.
sentences.zh: 还在呢。

sentences.en: Still in our closets.
sentences.zh: 还在我们的衣橱里。

sentences.en: Still surrounded by Josh's many, many hats.
sentences.zh: 依然被乔什那多到数不清的帽子包围着。

sentences.en: So many baseball hats.
sentences.zh: 好多棒球帽啊。

sentences.en: So many.
sentences.zh: 真的好多。

sentences.en: Does he have a favorite?
sentences.zh: 他有最喜欢的一顶吗？

sentences.en: Can we get him on the pod to ask him to give us a breakdown of these hats?
sentences.zh: 我们能请他上播客，让他给我们讲讲这些帽子吗？

sentences.en: Are they significant emotionally in some way?
sentences.zh: 它们在情感上有什么特殊意义吗？

sentences.en: Do they represent a team he loves?
sentences.zh: 它们代表他热爱的球队吗？

sentences.en: I mean, no.
sentences.zh: 我是说，并没有。

sentences.en: I think Josh is all about the fit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得乔什纯粹是为了穿搭效果。

sentences.en: And it looks like he loves the Patagonia kind of trucker-looking hat.
sentences.zh: 看起来他很喜欢那种巴塔哥尼亚风格的卡车司机帽。

sentences.en: It does with the adjustable band thing, the little plastic snappies.
sentences.zh: 确实，就是那种带调节带的，有塑料按扣的。

sentences.en: Josh, I hope you are excited that we shared.
sentences.zh: 乔什，希望你听到我们分享这些会感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Listen, there's other things in the closet.
sentences.zh: 听着，衣橱里还有别的东西。

sentences.en: Right over my shoulder, I notice all the time that there's the, what's the stuff they spray in their shoes, Jenna?
sentences.zh: 就在我肩膀后面，我一直注意到那个，就是他们喷在鞋子里的东西，叫什么来着，珍娜？

sentences.en: Febreze?
sentences.zh: 织物清新剂？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: All dudes do this.
sentences.zh: 所有男人都这样。

sentences.en: They spray that stuff in their shoes.
sentences.zh: 他们会把那东西喷在鞋子里。

sentences.en: Odor eaters?
sentences.zh: 除臭剂？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Anyway.
sentences.zh: 总之。

sentences.en: Oh, now, Josh, you're really happy.
sentences.zh: 噢，现在，乔什，你真的很高兴了吧。

sentences.en: I've shared with everyone that you spray your shoes.
sentences.zh: 我已经告诉大家你往鞋子里喷东西了。

sentences.en: Well, because we need to talk about this longer, I am really curious about the very bright red pair of shoes over your shoulder in the shoe cubby.
sentences.zh: 好吧，因为我们需要多聊聊这个，我真的很好奇你肩膀后面鞋架上那双非常鲜艳的红鞋。

sentences.en: Whose are those?
sentences.zh: 那是谁的？

sentences.en: Oh, those are my red converse.
sentences.zh: 噢，那是我的红色匡威鞋。

sentences.en: Okay, so here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: Yes, this is Josh's closet, but I occupy most of the shoe space.
sentences.zh: 没错，这是乔什的衣橱，但我占用了大部分放鞋的空间。

sentences.en: I have lots of shoes.
sentences.zh: 我有很多鞋子。

sentences.en: You have overflow that goes into his closet.
sentences.zh: 你的鞋子多到溢出来，都放进他的衣橱里了。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's real happy about it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他对此可高兴了。

sentences.en: Well, guys, it's what you're here for, a breakdown of Angela's closet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，伙计们，这就是你们来这儿的原因，解析安吉拉的衣橱。

sentences.en: Next week, we'll do my closet.
sentences.zh: 下周，我们来解析我的衣橱。

sentences.en: But this week, we are talking about chair model.
sentences.zh: 但本周，我们要聊的是《椅子模特》那一集。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Season 4, Episode 14, written by BJ Novak, directed by Jeffrey Blitz.
sentences.zh: 第四季第十四集，由BJ·诺瓦克编剧，杰弗里·布里茨执导。

sentences.en: With a duo like that, you know it's going to be good.
sentences.zh: 有这样的黄金搭档，你知道这集肯定错不了。

sentences.en: I love the simple idea that Michael has a thing for the model in a chair catalog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个简单的设定：迈克尔看上了椅子目录里的模特。

sentences.en: I just love how simple and perfect that is.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢这种简单而完美的设定。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Let me give you a summary.
sentences.zh: 让我为你做个总结。

sentences.en: Do it.
sentences.zh: 说吧。

sentences.en: Michael is unable to pick a new chair for his office after he becomes infatuated with a woman modeling office chairs in a catalog.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在目录里看中了一位办公椅模特，从此对她魂牵梦绕，导致他无法为自己的办公室挑选新椅子。

sentences.en: He decides he's ready to rejoin the dating pool.
sentences.zh: 他决定自己已经准备好重返约会市场了。

sentences.en: He's inspired by his love of the chair model.
sentences.zh: 他受到了对那位椅子模特的爱慕之情的启发。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Dunder Mifflin parking spaces are being used by a construction crew doing work for W.B.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，邓德·米夫林的停车位被一个为W.B.工作的施工队占用了。

sentences.en: Jones.
sentences.zh: 琼斯公司。

sentences.en: And the staff of Dunder Mifflin has to park in a satellite lot.
sentences.zh: 邓德·米夫林的员工们不得不把车停在远处的卫星停车场。

sentences.en: Kevin and Andy join forces to confront the other bosses of the Scranton Business Park to reclaim their places in the main lot.
sentences.zh: 凯文和安迪联手去质问斯克兰顿商业园的其他老板，试图夺回他们在主停车场的位置。

sentences.en: Simple storylines.
sentences.zh: 简单的故事情节。

sentences.en: Absolute perfection.
sentences.zh: 简直完美。

sentences.en: Also, absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 而且，绝对真实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, I had to park in a satellite lot when I had my admin job.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我以前做行政工作的时候也得停在卫星停车场。

sentences.en: If you were an executive, you could park in the parking lot of the building, this high rise in downtown Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 如果你是高管，你就能停在办公大楼的停车场里，就是洛杉矶市中心那栋高层建筑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I did not get a parking space.
sentences.zh: 我当时没分到停车位。

sentences.en: I had to park in a satellite lot that was about a half a mile away.
sentences.zh: 我得停在半英里外的一个卫星停车场。

sentences.en: And it wasn't a big deal, except for on days that it rained.
sentences.zh: 这倒没什么大不了的，除了下雨天之外。

sentences.en: Well, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关键是这样的。

sentences.en: You know where you rank in a company by where you park.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过停车的位置看出你在公司里的地位。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，确实。

sentences.en: Well, Michael has a spot right up front.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的停车位就在最前面。

sentences.en: He's not concerned.
sentences.zh: 他对此并不担心。

sentences.en: Well, later he's going to try to imagine what it would be like if he didn't have that spot.
sentences.zh: 不过后来他会试着想象如果他没有那个车位会是什么样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But it takes two employees angrily confronting him for him to get there.
sentences.zh: 但直到两名员工愤怒地找他理论，他才意识到这一点。

sentences.en: What are our fast facts, Jenna?
sentences.zh: 我们的速览事实是什么，珍娜？

sentences.en: Fast fact number one.
sentences.zh: 速览事实第一条。

sentences.en: The original title of this episode was Michael Dating.
sentences.zh: 这一集的最初标题是《迈克尔约会》。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But they realized that they would have to release the name of the episode before Dinner Party had aired.
sentences.zh: 但他们意识到，他们必须在《晚宴》那一集播出之前公布这一集的名称。

sentences.en: Oh, and they didn't want that.
sentences.zh: 噢，他们不想那样。

sentences.en: They didn't want to ruin the surprise about Jan and Michael's breakup, right?
sentences.zh: 他们不想破坏简和迈克尔分手带来的惊喜，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they changed the name of the episode to Parking.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把这一集的标题改成了《停车》。

sentences.en: But then they felt, well, while it's a big part of the episode, it's not the main storyline of the episode.
sentences.zh: 但后来他们觉得，虽然停车是这一集的重要部分，但它并不是主线剧情。

sentences.en: So they eventually settled on Chair Model, which I personally love.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终定名为《椅子模特》，我个人非常喜欢这个名字。

sentences.en: I mean, when you see that, aren't you intrigued?
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你看到这个标题时，难道不会感到好奇吗？

sentences.en: I'm so intrigued.
sentences.zh: 我太好奇了。

sentences.en: What is this episode going to be about?
sentences.zh: 这一集到底讲什么呢？

sentences.en: Chair Model.
sentences.zh: 《椅子模特》。

sentences.en: I'm more intrigued than Parking.
sentences.zh: 比《停车》更让我好奇。

sentences.en: I'll say that.
sentences.zh: 我得这么说。

sentences.en: They picked the right one.
sentences.zh: 他们选对了标题。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Fast fact number two.
sentences.zh: 速览事实第二条。

sentences.en: I think we need to do a little breakdown of the Scranton Business Park five families.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们需要稍微剖析一下斯克兰顿商业园的“五大家族”。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like Goodfellas.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就像《好家伙》一样。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here are the bosses of the five families.
sentences.zh: 这几位就是五大家族的掌门人。

sentences.en: Michael Scott, of course, Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration.
sentences.zh: 当然有迈克尔·斯科特，还有万斯制冷的鲍勃·万斯。

sentences.en: Then there is W.B.
sentences.zh: 接着是W.B.

sentences.en: Jones from W.B.
sentences.zh: 来自W.B.的琼斯。

sentences.en: Jones Heating and Air.
sentences.zh: 琼斯冷暖设备公司。

sentences.en: He was played by Barry Sigismondi, Bill Kress of Kress, Tool, and Die, who was played by Terrence Beeser.
sentences.zh: 他由巴里·西吉斯蒙迪饰演，还有克雷斯模具公司的比尔·克雷斯，由特伦斯·比瑟饰演。

sentences.en: And finally, Paul Faust of Disaster Kits Limited, who was played by Paul FauSt.
sentences.zh: 最后是灾难应急包有限公司的保罗·福斯特，由保罗·福斯特本人饰演。

sentences.en: This is an amazing story.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个神奇的故事。

sentences.en: And it all starts when an actual man named Paul Faust came to visit the set of The Office.
sentences.zh: 这一切都要从一个叫保罗·福斯特的真实人物去参观《办公室》片场说起。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I have known Paul Faust for years.
sentences.zh: 我和保罗·福斯特认识很多年了。

sentences.en: We used to be related by marriage.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经是姻亲。

sentences.en: And I reached out to him.
sentences.zh: 我联系了他。

sentences.en: And he is just such a hoot.
sentences.zh: 他真是个风趣的人。

sentences.en: And he sent in all of these fantastic audio clips about his day on set.
sentences.zh: 他发来了一堆关于他在片场那天的精彩音频片段。

sentences.en: They are amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And in this first one, he explains exactly how he got the role on the show.
sentences.zh: 在第一个片段里，他详细讲述了自己是如何得到这个角色的。

sentences.en: Sam, you got to play this clip.
sentences.zh: 山姆，你得放一下这段音频。

sentences.en: Hey, office ladies and office fans.
sentences.zh: 嘿，各位《办公室》的女士们和粉丝们。

sentences.en: This is Paul Faust, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 我是保罗·福斯特，也就是大家说的。

sentences.en: Cool Guy Paul.
sentences.zh: 酷哥保罗。

sentences.en: I want to tell you how I got a part of the show.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你们我是怎么得到这个角色的。

sentences.en: So I was out in L.A.
sentences.zh: 当时我在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: on business and decided to visit the set because my cousins are part of the office.
sentences.zh: 出差，顺便决定去片场参观，因为我的表亲是《办公室》剧组的成员。

sentences.en: And when I was out there, I met the writers.
sentences.zh: 在那儿的时候，我见到了编剧们。

sentences.en: And I kind of told them one of my companies and what I did, which was a company that sells disaster kits.
sentences.zh: 我跟他们提到了我的公司和我的业务，那是一家卖灾难应急包的公司。

sentences.en: And Greg had said, this is my cousin.
sentences.zh: 格雷格当时说，这是我表弟。

sentences.en: He's a little nuts.
sentences.zh: 他有点疯。

sentences.en: Tell him what you do.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们你是做什么的。

sentences.en: I told him about the company.
sentences.zh: 我向他们介绍了我的公司。

sentences.en: And when I walked out of the room, unbeknownst to me, BJ Novak said, that guy's got to be a character on the show.
sentences.zh: 我走出房间后，我不知道的是，B.J.诺瓦克说，那家伙一定要在剧里演个角色。

sentences.en: So he wrote a part based on me.
sentences.zh: 于是他以我为原型写了一个角色。

sentences.en: And the day before they shot the scene, they hadn't found an actor to play the part.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄那场戏的前一天，他们还没找到合适的演员来演这个角色。

sentences.en: So I got a call asking me if I wanted to audition to play the part.
sentences.zh: 所以我接到了电话，问我想不想去试镜演这个角色。

sentences.en: And long story short, I got the part, got to fly out and be part of the awesome show and play myself.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，我拿到了角色，飞过去参与了这部超棒的剧，并且演了我自己。

sentences.en: So that's how I got to be on the show.
sentences.zh: 这就是我参演的过程。

sentences.en: It's really a story only can happen in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 这真是个只有在好莱坞才会发生的故事。

sentences.en: I mean, that's bonkers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: He's literally playing himself.
sentences.zh: 他真的是在演他自己。

sentences.en: But what's bonkers to me about it was that they did hold auditions.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得最疯狂的是，他们竟然还举行了试镜。

sentences.en: They held auditions for this role.
sentences.zh: 他们为这个角色举行了试镜。

sentences.en: And the night before, they just had not found someone who could play Paul FauSt.
sentences.zh: 直到前一天晚上，他们还没找到能演保罗·福斯特的人。

sentences.en: So they're like, how about Paul Faust?
sentences.zh: 于是他们想，要不就让保罗·福斯特本人来演？

sentences.en: Paul really sells disaster kits.
sentences.zh: 保罗是真的在卖灾难应急包。

sentences.en: That's real.
sentences.zh: 那是真的。

sentences.en: That is his company.
sentences.zh: 那是他自己的公司。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: And Angela, he talked about that in this next clip.
sentences.zh: 还有安吉拉，他在下一段视频里谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: I think one of the most unique things about me being in the office was that I actually played myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在办公室里最独特的一点就是，我其实是在演我自己。

sentences.en: When I went out to L.A.
sentences.zh: 当我去了洛杉矶，

sentences.en: and I was visiting and I went to the set, I talked about one of the businesses I run,
sentences.zh: 去探班的时候，我提到了我经营的一家公司，

sentences.en: which is a company called 1-800-PREPARE, 1-800-PREPARE.com,
sentences.zh: 那是一家叫1-800-PREPARE的公司，1-800-PREPARE.com，

sentences.en: where we actually sell disaster kits and preparedness kits.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上是在卖灾难应急包和防灾包。

sentences.en: So I talked about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我提到了这件事。

sentences.en: And that's what DJ had picked up on.
sentences.zh: 而这正是DJ注意到的地方。

sentences.en: And so he wrote a part called about Cool Guy Paul, the owner of Disaster Kits Limited.
sentences.zh: 于是他写了一个角色，叫酷哥保罗，是灾难应急有限公司的老板。

sentences.en: And, yes, I still own that company.
sentences.zh: 而且，没错，我至今仍拥有那家公司。

sentences.en: We still sell disaster kits.
sentences.zh: 我们还在卖灾难应急包。

sentences.en: So I think I'm one of the few people who played himself on TV with his real name in a real business that he runs,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我是为数不多在电视上用真名、演自己、经营着真实业务的人之一，

sentences.en: which was kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 这感觉挺酷的。

sentences.en: So we asked Paul, how did he prepare, you know, to have these scenes?
sentences.zh: 所以我们问了保罗，他是怎么准备这些戏份的？

sentences.en: He's not an actor.
sentences.zh: 他不是演员。

sentences.en: He's not used to learning lines or where to sit, you know, how to navigate a set and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他不习惯背台词，不知道该坐哪儿，也不懂怎么在片场走位之类的东西。

sentences.en: And here's what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 来看看他是怎么说的。

sentences.en: So I got this part, let's say, on a Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我大概是在周四拿到了这个角色。

sentences.en: And I had we were shooting Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 然后我们周五早上就要拍摄了。

sentences.en: So I had about a good 10 hours to learn my five or six lines.
sentences.zh: 所以我大概有10个小时的时间来背那五六句台词。

sentences.en: So I'm studying, studying on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我在飞机上一直在学，一直在学。

sentences.en: I'm reading them.
sentences.zh: 我一直在读它们。

sentences.en: I didn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我没睡觉。

sentences.en: I studied them.
sentences.zh: 我一直在背。

sentences.en: So we go there and this whole experience happens.
sentences.zh: 然后我们到了那里，经历了这一切。

sentences.en: And you're nervous.
sentences.zh: 你会感到紧张。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of people around.
sentences.zh: 周围有很多工作人员。

sentences.en: Yeah, we must have owned it for a bit.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们肯定拥有过它一段时间。

sentences.en: And we clearly don't own it anymore.
sentences.zh: 显然我们现在已经不再拥有它了。

sentences.en: We really don't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有了。

sentences.en: Well, the other fun fact I have about this little montage is that at 10 minutes, 55 seconds,
sentences.zh: 好吧，关于这个小剪辑我还有另一个有趣的事实，在 10 分 55 秒的时候，

sentences.en: we see a photo of cool guy Paul sitting on a motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了一张酷哥保罗坐在摩托车上的照片。

sentences.en: And there's a very interesting story here.
sentences.zh: 这里面有个非常有趣的故事。

sentences.en: Sam, will you play this clip from Paul?
sentences.zh: 山姆，能播放一下保罗的这段录音吗？

sentences.en: Hey, so a quick story about that motorcycle picture, because a lot of people ask me,
sentences.zh: 嘿，关于那张摩托车照片有个简短的故事，因为很多人问我，

sentences.en: is that your motorcycle?
sentences.zh: 那是你的摩托车吗？

sentences.en: And no, it's actually we were shooting the scenes and we were supposed to shoot somewhere
sentences.zh: 其实不是，当时我们正在拍戏，原本应该去某个人的房子后面，

sentences.en: on some guy's house in the back deck overlooking the ocean, but it got late in the day
sentences.zh: 在俯瞰大海的后甲板上拍摄，但天色已晚，

sentences.en: and they didn't want to move the whole crew and the cameras and the lighting and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们不想搬动整个剧组、摄像机、灯光以及所有那些设备。

sentences.en: So right behind the lot where they shoot all the scenes where the office is, is a residential neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 所以，在拍摄办公室场景的摄影棚后面，正好是一个居民区。

sentences.en: So we went through the fence and it was some guy's house and we just set up on the front lawn.
sentences.zh: 于是我们穿过栅栏，那是某人的房子，我们就直接在前草坪上布置了场景。

sentences.en: I believe it was the motorcycle of one of the camera guys.
sentences.zh: 我相信那是其中一位摄影师的摩托车。

sentences.en: He happens to ride motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 他刚好骑摩托车。

sentences.en: So he brought his motorcycle around.
sentences.zh: 所以他把摩托车骑了过来。

sentences.en: I sat on it.
sentences.zh: 我坐在上面。

sentences.en: We took a bunch of pictures and that just became the shot associated with cool guy Paul.
sentences.zh: 我们拍了一堆照片，那张照片就成了酷哥保罗的标志性镜头。

sentences.en: And it saved having to move everybody to another location and spend hours doing it.
sentences.zh: 这省去了把所有人转移到另一个地点并花费数小时拍摄的麻烦。

sentences.en: So people always ask me, are you a motorcycle?
sentences.zh: 所以人们总是问我，你是骑摩托车的吗？

sentences.en: How'd you get the motorcycle?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么弄到那辆摩托车的？

sentences.en: But nope, it was just a quick shot of one of the crew members' motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 但并没有，那只是剧组成员摩托车的随手一拍。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I reached out to Kenneth Paul, who did my makeup on the show, because he rode a Harley, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，珍娜，我联系了在剧中负责我化妆的肯尼斯·保罗，因为他骑的是哈雷，对吧？

sentences.en: To set.
sentences.zh: 去片场。

sentences.en: Every day to work.
sentences.zh: 每天上班都骑。

sentences.en: And I sent him the picture and I said, Kenneth Paul, is this your motorcycle?
sentences.zh: 我把照片发给他，我说，肯尼斯·保罗，这是你的摩托车吗？

sentences.en: And he said, no, Angela, that's not a Harley.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，安吉拉，那不是哈雷。

sentences.en: It's not mine.
sentences.zh: 不是我的。

sentences.en: So we don't know whose motorcycle it was, but I think that was Tom Melby's yard.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道那是谁的摩托车，但我认为那是汤姆·梅尔比的院子。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，肯定的。

sentences.en: When I heard Paul's clip and he said we went to some guy's yard through a fence, Tom Melby was our, I guess, general maintenance guy on the show.
sentences.zh: 当我听到保罗的录音，他说我们穿过栅栏去了某个人的院子时，汤姆·梅尔比是我们剧组的，我想应该是总务维护人员。

sentences.en: He was always fixing things.
sentences.zh: 他总是负责修理东西。

sentences.en: When we went on vacations, he was the person who watered the plants.
sentences.zh: 当我们去度假时，他就是那个负责浇花的人。

sentences.en: And he lived right behind the set in a house.
sentences.zh: 他就住在片场后面的一栋房子里。

sentences.en: I loved the idea that cool guy Paul was originally going to be filmed, like, in a big mansion with the ocean behind him.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢那个点子，原本酷酷的保罗是要在那种大豪宅里拍摄的，背景还得是大海。

sentences.en: It definitely tracks, right?
sentences.zh: 这绝对说得通，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then they had to scramble and they're like, what else is cool?
sentences.zh: 但后来他们不得不临时改方案，他们就在想，还有什么东西很酷？

sentences.en: Ooh, a motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 噢，摩托车。

sentences.en: And I kind of love the motorcycle better, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我反而更喜欢摩托车。

sentences.en: I do, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: So, Jenna, at 11 minutes, 30 seconds, it is time for Michael to go on his date.
sentences.zh: 那么，珍娜，在11分30秒的时候，迈克尔该去约会了。

sentences.en: He's at the coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 他到了咖啡店。

sentences.en: He's a little early, so he's going to go ahead and get a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 他去早了一点，所以打算先买杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Oh, here's his order.
sentences.zh: 噢，这是他点的单。

sentences.en: Large hot chocolate with caramel and a shot of peppermint.
sentences.zh: 大杯热巧克力，加焦糖和一份薄荷糖浆。

sentences.en: He's going to pay for it with his, did you notice, bejeweled wallet?
sentences.zh: 他要用他的钱包付钱，你注意到了吗，那个镶满宝石的钱包？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 没有！

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: It's really subtle, but if you freeze at 11 minutes, 26 seconds, Michael is paying for his coffee.
sentences.zh: 真的很隐蔽，但如果你在11分26秒暂停，就能看到迈克尔在付咖啡钱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And his wallet has an outline of little bedazzled fuchsia geMs.
sentences.zh: 他的钱包轮廓上镶着一圈紫红色的水钻。

sentences.en: I am so curious why.
sentences.zh: 我太好奇为什么了。

sentences.en: Did Jan get bored and bedazzle everything in their whole condo one day?
sentences.zh: 是不是简有一天无聊了，把他们公寓里的所有东西都贴上了水钻？

sentences.en: Perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I looked at it so closely, there's no name on it.
sentences.zh: 我仔细看了看，上面没有名字。

sentences.en: It's just an outline.
sentences.zh: 就只是个轮廓。

sentences.en: I need to see that.
sentences.zh: 我一定要看看那个。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: Well, he's looking around and he's trying to figure out where's his date.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他在四处张望，想找出他的约会对象在哪里。

sentences.en: He's wearing a rose on his lapel, right?
sentences.zh: 他在翻领上别了一朵玫瑰，对吧？

sentences.en: Because that's how you'll know it's him.
sentences.zh: 因为那样你才知道是他。

sentences.en: Could you imagine if Michael was in The Bachelor, that reality show?
sentences.zh: 你能想象迈克尔去参加《单身汉》那个真人秀吗？

sentences.en: So crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That would be so good.
sentences.zh: 那一定会很精彩。

sentences.en: I was thinking the other day, what would I be like on The Bachelor?
sentences.zh: 我前几天还在想，如果我去参加《单身汉》会是什么样？

sentences.en: Oh, God, you wouldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你才不会去呢。

sentences.en: You'd say, oh, right, all these women have to kiss the same guy.
sentences.zh: 你会说，噢，好吧，所有这些女人都得亲同一个男人。

sentences.en: F you, patriarchy.
sentences.zh: 去你的父权制。

sentences.en: He wouldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 他才不会去。

sentences.en: But then I was sort of like daydreaming about me getting out of the limo in my joggers and a hoodie.
sentences.zh: 但我当时就在做白日梦，想象我穿着慢跑裤和连帽衫从豪华轿车里走出来。

sentences.en: And just keeping it super real.
sentences.zh: 就保持最真实的状态。

sentences.en: I was like, dude, I'm getting out of the limo how you're going to see me most of the time after we have two kids.
sentences.zh: 我就想，伙计，我下车时的样子就是我们生了两个孩子后你大部分时间会看到的样子。

sentences.en: And if you love me now, you're going to love me then.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在爱我，那你以后也会爱我。

sentences.en: And I think we should start this way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该从这种方式开始。

sentences.en: That'd be my pitch.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的推销词。

sentences.en: You literally said that with like a snarl in your lip.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说那话的时候，嘴唇都撇起来了。

sentences.en: You're like, this is.
sentences.zh: 你当时的样子就是，这就是。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我确实撇了。

sentences.en: It's badass.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: It's a badass way to start a date.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常酷的约会开场方式。

sentences.en: If you're getting out of a limo on my first date, you've already lost me.
sentences.zh: 如果第一次约会你就从豪华轿车里走出来，那你已经失去我了。

sentences.en: So true.
sentences.zh: 太对了。

sentences.en: If you want to dial up the douchery, show up in your limo.
sentences.zh: 如果你想把那种混蛋劲儿发挥到极致，那就坐着豪华轿车出现吧。

sentences.en: Well, Michael sees a woman.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔看到了一个女人。

sentences.en: It's such a funny line.
sentences.zh: 那句台词太搞笑了。

sentences.en: He says, I'm looking for a woman in blue jeans and a black top with brown hair.
sentences.zh: 他说，我在找一个穿蓝色牛仔裤、黑色上衣、留着棕色头发的女人。

sentences.en: And he goes, there she is.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，就是她了。

sentences.en: And the camera swings to a blonde.
sentences.zh: 镜头转向了一个金发女郎。

sentences.en: A tall blonde.
sentences.zh: 一个高个子金发女郎。

sentences.en: Wearing a skirt.
sentences.zh: 穿着裙子。

sentences.en: Like a floral skirt with a top.
sentences.zh: 就像那种花裙子配上衣。

sentences.en: Clearly not the description he was given.
sentences.zh: 显然和别人描述给他的完全不一样。

sentences.en: But he says, there she is.
sentences.zh: 但他还是说，就是她了。

sentences.en: I give her a 10 for looks and a 3 for describing herself.
sentences.zh: 我给她的外貌打10分，但对自己描述的准确度打3分。

sentences.en: Oh, he's so charmed.
sentences.zh: 噢，他被迷住了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Obviously, the woman in the dress is not his date.
sentences.zh: 显然，那个穿裙子的女人不是他的约会对象。

sentences.en: Since she's dressed nothing as described.
sentences.zh: 因为她的打扮和描述的完全不符。

sentences.en: But then, Pam's landlady walks in, Margaret, wearing jeans and a black top.
sentences.zh: 但随后，帕姆的房东玛格丽特走了进来，穿着牛仔裤和黑色上衣。

sentences.en: And Michael gets one look at her.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔看了她一眼。

sentences.en: He's clearly disappointed.
sentences.zh: 他明显很失望。

sentences.en: And he tries to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 他试图找借口溜走。

sentences.en: Oh, it's so cringy.
sentences.zh: 噢，真是太尴尬了。

sentences.en: And she's really cute.
sentences.zh: 而且她真的很可爱。

sentences.en: And like, nice.
sentences.zh: 而且，人也很好。

sentences.en: Like, what is wrong with Michael?
sentences.zh: 就是说，迈克尔到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Michael has such a bad picker.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的眼光真是太差了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, Pam's landlady was played by Brooke Dillman.
sentences.zh: 嗯，帕姆的房东是由布鲁克·迪尔曼饰演的。

sentences.en: She is an improv comedy actress.
sentences.zh: 她是一位即兴喜剧演员。

sentences.en: She starred in this sketch comedy show called Blue Collar TV.
sentences.zh: 她曾主演过一个叫《蓝领电视》的素描喜剧节目。

sentences.en: And by the way, she has voiced several characters on Bob's Burger.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，她还为《鲍勃汉堡店》里的几个角色配过音。

sentences.en: She's amazing.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: She's just got the chops.
sentences.zh: 她非常有实力。

sentences.en: Brooke is hilarious.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克非常搞笑。

sentences.en: I have just known her through improv circles over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来我一直通过即兴表演圈子认识她。

sentences.en: And she's so funny.
sentences.zh: 她真的非常幽默。

sentences.en: And, you know, I know her role as Margaret was supposed to be understated.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我知道她饰演玛格丽特这个角色本应是内敛的。

sentences.en: And I just wish you guys could see the comedy chop she has.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望你们能看到她所具备的喜剧功底。

sentences.en: I know you see it in her timing of the scene and all of that.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们从她在那场戏里的节奏感等等都能看出来。

sentences.en: But she is really, really funny.
sentences.zh: 但她真的、真的非常搞笑。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of times it takes a great comedic performer to play restraint.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多时候需要一位伟大的喜剧表演者才能演好那种克制。

sentences.en: Yeah, to have the patience to play the restraint.
sentences.zh: 是的，要有耐心去演绎那种克制。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to not try to overload the scene with their own bits.
sentences.zh: 而且不能试图用自己的包袱去塞满整场戏。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And she does it perfectly.
sentences.zh: 而她完成得非常完美。

sentences.en: Incidentally, she graduated from the University of Missouri's theater program.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，她毕业于密苏里大学的戏剧专业。

sentences.en: Good old Mizzou.
sentences.zh: 老牌的密苏里大学。

sentences.en: That was about 90 minutes away from the school that I went to in Kirksville, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 那离我在密苏里州柯克斯维尔上的学校大约有90分钟的路程。

sentences.en: I had to drive through Mizzou, Columbia, Missouri, to get to Kirksville.
sentences.zh: 我得开车经过密苏里州的哥伦比亚市，也就是密苏里大学所在地，才能到达柯克斯维尔。

sentences.en: You and Brooke crisscrossing.
sentences.zh: 你和布鲁克真是交错而行啊。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: We're both two gals from theater schools in Missouri who landed on the office.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都是来自密苏里州戏剧学校的姑娘，最后都进了这间办公室。

sentences.en: Go Mo.
sentences.zh: 密苏里加油。

sentences.en: The scene between Margaret and Michael is so cringy.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特和迈克尔的那场戏真是尴尬得让人脚趾扣地。

sentences.en: Michael literally is like rubbing his forehead like he's in pain.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔简直就像是在揉额头，好像很痛苦一样。

sentences.en: He's like, so you get the rent checks every month?
sentences.zh: 他说，所以你每个月都能收到房租支票？

sentences.en: And she's like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 她说，是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: He's like, and then what do you do with them?
sentences.zh: 他说，那你收到之后都干什么呢？

sentences.en: And she goes, are you really asking me what I do with the checks that people give me?
sentences.zh: 她说，你真的在问我怎么处理别人给我的支票吗？

sentences.en: And he's like, I'm just, I'm trying to make conversation, okay?
sentences.zh: 他说，我只是，我只是想找点话题聊聊，行吗？

sentences.en: Oh, Michael.
sentences.zh: 噢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And he just talks about like, he goes, well, this is who I was dating before you.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始说，他说，好吧，这是我在和你交往之前约会过的人。

sentences.en: And he shows the photo of Jan.
sentences.zh: 接着他展示了简的照片。

sentences.en: And then he calls her by accident.
sentences.zh: 然后他不小心拨通了她的电话。

sentences.en: It's just like layer of layer of cringy.
sentences.zh: 这简直是尴尬一层叠着一层。

sentences.en: And then he kind of starts opening up to Margaret about like how it's so hard to find someone.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始向玛格丽特敞开心扉，说找个人有多难。

sentences.en: And he tells her, you know, thanks.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，你知道，谢谢你。

sentences.en: This has been nice.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真不错。

sentences.en: It's like talking to the old lady on the bus.
sentences.zh: 就像是在和公交车上的老太太聊天一样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And Margaret's had it.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: She's like, you're rude.
sentences.zh: 她说，你真没礼貌。

sentences.en: That was rude.
sentences.zh: 那太没礼貌了。

sentences.en: Well, and then Michael says, well, now you've ruined it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，然后迈克尔说，好吧，现在你把它搞砸了。

sentences.en: Michael was such a jerk in this scene.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在这场戏里真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: Listen, if you had any sympathy for him after dinner party, it evaporated after this scene.
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你在“晚宴”那集之后对他还有点同情心，看完这场戏就全没了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We were very good at taking you on quite the roller coaster as your feelings for Michael are concerned on this show.
sentences.zh: 我们很擅长让观众在看这部剧时，对迈克尔的感情像坐过山车一样起伏。

sentences.en: But at this scene, I was like, you deserve Jan.
sentences.zh: 但在这场戏里，我的想法是，你活该和简在一起。

sentences.en: You deserve to sleep on the bench at the foot of the bed.
sentences.zh: 你活该睡在床尾的长凳上。

sentences.en: You're being such a turd.
sentences.zh: 你真是个烂人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's very complicated.
sentences.zh: 这非常复杂。

sentences.en: Well, now we go into this wonderful scene where Andy and Kevin are going to meet with the heads of the five families.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我们进入了那场精彩的戏，安迪和凯文要去见五大家族的头目。

sentences.en: Yeah.
